newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin down four cents to 13.84 rgt/kg on LME fall.
newsitem.headline: KL tin down four cents to 13.84 rgt/kg on LME fall.

text.p: Malaysia's spot tin price fell four cents to 13.84 ringgit ($5.23) a kg on Friday after tracking an overnight fall on the London Metal Exchange (LME), traders said.
"The LME moved down on correction and the local market followed," said a tin trader in Malaysia.
Dealers said the local price was at a premium of $20 against the LME, compared to $5 on Thursday.
At the opening on Friday, there were initial sales offers for 113 tonnes against bids for 51 tonnes.
Final turnover was 78 tonnes, from 116 on Thursday, and was absorbed by European, Japanese and local interests.
Traders said resistance for the current price was still at 14 ringgit.
